answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes. Each applicant posts a 20-unit deposit, locked 20 epochs, released only after steady tasks and stable counterparties. Auditors check timing and error rates, so velvet hides no copied pattern. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2000 units sunk, while one honest agent pays once and recovers its deposit. A herd that wanders over a ridge of accounts leaves matching fingerprints and loses deposits.
